name: 效果测试插件
description: 霓虹参数动画与 Python 粒子风洞，用于验证持久对象和实时预览。

start.description: Start neon or wind; repeat returns same running scene.

configure.description: Change a running scene without restarting it.

status.description: Read active preview URLs and revisions.

stop.description: Stop one scene and release its server and background thread.
